d2.method: Within-season ridge margin ratings using exact NCAA source team slugs, final scores, and a fitted home-court term. Ratings are descriptive historical evidence, not a 2026-27 forecast.

quality.stable_team_key: publisher team slug; rows without slug are excluded
quality.identity_join: none; no name-only join to ESPN, SportsDataverse, or another provider

backtest.method: Chronological 80/20 within-season holdout; ratings fit only on the earlier games and no target-season rows are used.

target_schedule.note: No 2026-27 NCAA lower-division schedule rows are present in the retained exact-division capture.

readiness.detail: Every retained row was requested with NCAA division=2.
Publisher team slugs are used as source-local keys; missing slugs are excluded.
4,576 finals retain two teams, scores, and contest IDs.
Chronological 80/20 within-season holdout; ratings fit only on the earlier games and no target-season rows are used.
A future-game forecast requires a target-season schedule with the same exact scope.
Only the 2025 NCAA seasonYear capture is retained; one season cannot establish interseason transfer or roster continuity.

limitations: This is a historical within-season rating and backtest, not a published prediction model.
No 2026-27 target schedule is present, so no future lower-division game probabilities or scores are emitted.
The model uses final scores and venue only; player availability, transfers, injuries, and opponent-strength priors are not modeled.
Rows missing a publisher team slug remain in exclusion counts and never become name-derived identities.
